title: Canary Deployments with Istio — Companion Manifests
title_es: Despliegues Canary con Istio — Manifiestos complementarios
description: Complete Istio canary deployment setup: versioned Deployments, DestinationRule subsets with outlier detection, weighted VirtualService routing, header-based and traffic-mirroring variants, circuit breaking, a progressive rollout script, and a Flagger Canary resource for automated metric-gated promotion, accompanying the Istio canary deployment recipe.
description_es: Configuración completa de despliegue canary con Istio: Deployments versionados, subsets de DestinationRule con outlier detection, enrutado ponderado con VirtualService, variantes por cabecera y de espejado de tráfico, circuit breaking, un script de rollout progresivo y un recurso Canary de Flagger para promoción automática basada en métricas, que acompañan a la receta de despliegue canary con Istio.
